events.label: Наука
entries: 2020 – The Utah monolith, built sometime in 2016 is discovered by state biologists of the Utah Division of Wildlife Resources.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1883 – In the "day of two noons", American and Canadian railroad companies institute four standard continental time zones, ending the confusion of thousands of local times.
1944 – The Popular Socialist Youth is founded in Cuba.
1991 – The autonomous Croatian Community of Herzeg-Bosnia, which would in 1993 become a republic, was established in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
1999 – At Texas A&M University, the Aggie Bonfire collapses killing 12 students and injuring 27 others.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1910 – In their campaign for women's voting rights, hundreds of suffragettes march to the British Parliament in London. Several are beaten by police, newspaper attention embarrasses the authorities, and the march is dubbed Black Friday.
1985 – The first comic of Calvin and Hobbes is published in ten newspapers.
